summary: A supporter asks for a committee report so future readers can tell what lawmakers meant.
realLife: Wayne Morse backed civil rights and sought referral to document the Senate’s intent. His motion lost.
gates: A bill has reached the floor without committee review.
inGame: committee-hearing records testimony. needs: a floor motion seeking referral specifically to document legislative intent.

turns.what: The ally accepts a floor explanation and withdraws the referral motion.
turns.pulledBy: The sponsor answers the disputed interpretation on the record.
turns.writesBack: The explanation remains available and the referral motion is withdrawn.

turns.what: The ally narrows the request to one section.
turns.pulledBy: Members accept the need for testimony on that section alone.
turns.writesBack: The proposed referral names a single section.
